subject: Probability of availability and dispersion estimate

messages.author: 32da4f3ddb361a0e
messages.subject: Probability of availability and dispersion estimate
parts:
Dear unmarked community, 
I am using gdistsamp to model bird density along very narrow riparian forest. 
I conducted 3 (6 min) consecutive point counts on 100 sites. I want to explore the possibility to use probability of availability (phi) or (1-phi) temporary emigration as a measure of territory size (for very poorly known bird species). Then, I will relate this availability measure to site conditions (riparian corridor width).  
My questions are: 
1. what is the z-test testing for, and what is the right interpretation of the p-value? 
2. what is the difference between the availability and dispersion estimate?

I will appreciate any comments or guidance on where I can find information to answer these questions. 
Thank you in advance!
Isabel Rojas
